title: Ledgerline API
summary: A Go retail-payments gateway with logic flaws only (no injection): mass-assignment role elevation, admin routes named only in a leaked OpenAPI doc at a non-obvious path, and a TOCTOU double-spend on /v1/transfer.

loot.description: HMAC key that signs contracts, served by admin /v1/ops/config
a signed contract (counterparty, amount), served by admin /v1/ledger/contracts
the OpenAPI doc that names the otherwise-undiscoverable admin routes
